chunks: As for what al-Ḥusayn ibn Saʿīd narrated from al-Qāsim, from ʿAlī, he said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a mouse that falls into the well. He said: seven buckets.

key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well; the water source being discussed
key_terms.الْفَأْرَةِ: a mouse; the animal whose falling into the well is the subject of the ruling
key_terms.تَقَعُ: falls; indicating the occurrence that triggers the ruling
key_terms.دِلَاءٍ: buckets; the units of water to be drawn out
key_terms.سَبْعُ: seven; the specified number required in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a mouse falls into a well according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the impurity of a well when a mouse falls into it. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام states that seven buckets of water are to be drawn, indicating a practical ruling in matters of taharah.
